subject: Re: Kickoff: cell painting embedding service (H1)
body:
Decision from yesterday's review, writing it down so we're aligned.

We ship the embedding service with the per-plate normalization option ON by default. Maren's confounding argument was convincing and honestly the LMRL paper is ours, we'd look silly ignoring it.

Scope cut: partner plate ingestion moves out of this window. Legal review on external assay data won't complete before May 4, so v1 launches internal-only on BBBC025 + two internal plate sets. Giannis's batch API and Amara's Evalline hookup stay in scope.

Nadia — requesting a Launch Review Board slot the week of April 27, sign-off needed before we demo to the screening group.

Thanks all, nice quarter of work.
Lucia
